Notes on the Operating

Notes on the switch cabinet 
The switch cabinet has protection class IP 55 as standard.  The ambient air must be able to freely 
circulate around the switch cabinet and must not be heated up by other heat generators. 
 
Bags with desiccant may have been suspended inside the switch cabinet. 
The desiccant protects the electrical components from humidity during transport and short term storage. 
Before starting up the control system, the bags of drying agent must be removed from the switch cabinet. 
 
If any of the bags of drying agent are defective, any drying agent that has escaped must be removed from 
the switch cabinet.  
 Always ensure that the switch cabinet is on a firm  surface and that the interior is clean in order to 
avoid malfunctions. 
 
 
NOTE! Unsuitable hoisting gear and lifting accessories! 
Material damage.

 Pay attention to the markings on the packing units.

2.1 Functional description of the XSS® (XSS® sortin g system) 
Functional 
description 
Conveyors feed the material to the X-ray sorting system. 
 
A conveyor belt feeds the material through the X-ray scanner that detects the 
different substances. The control unit controls the respective pneumatic valves 
arranged in a row downstream of the belt drum. 
The detected material is blown out of the material flow with compressed air in 
downward direction. 
 
An electric motor drives the conveyor belt. 
The conveyor belt speed (m/sec) is fixed. 
 
The STXSS®_2015 control unit is located in a switch cabinet. 
The EMERGENCY STOP devices, the operating panel displaying status, error 
messages and other plant parameters are also located in this switch cabinet. 
 
The control system (Microsoft Windows) passes a signal to the relevant valve in 
the valve strip (several adjacent valves at the end of the belt). The valve opens 
for an extremely short time and shoots the part to separate over a fixed or 
rotating splitter (rotating splitter is optional) using a powerful jet of air. The valve 
opening time is adapted to the size and shape of the material that is being sorted 
if necessary. 
 
Depending on the material fed in, the separated constituents are deposited in a 
material discharge upstream or downstream of the splitter.
